description: Use a three-sample effective window for even window_size and extrapolate the line defined by two valid fiducial levels.

oracle.description: window_size 2 gives radius 1 and levels mean([2,4,8]) = 14/3 at position 2 and mean([8,16,32]) = 56/3 at position 4. The unique line through those levels has slope 7 and is evaluated across positions 1 through 5.
